change_scope: pandora-projectos-learning Edge Function source and its behavioral test suite. No schema change, no deployment, no production data mutation.

review_remediation.finding: the changed-content 409 was returned before audit reconciliation
review_remediation.consequence: after an earlier audit-write failure, a changed-content retry reconciled review and digest and then returned 409 without ever writing the audit row, stranding persisted candidate/review/digest state permanently without mandatory audit evidence
review_remediation.fix: audit reconciliation now runs before the conflict decision, on the same principle already applied to the review item and digest: the audit row is evidence about the persisted candidate, not about the request in flight

behavior_contract.recovery_source_of_truth: persisted candidate row, never the retry content
behavior_contract.reconciliation_order: candidate, review item, digest, audit, THEN conflict decision

audit_durability.audit_failure_on_changed_retry: surfaces as audit_persistence_failed, not masked behind 409

test_evidence.limitation: a fake Supabase client is used; PostgREST and Postgres constraint behavior, including the 23505 path, is not exercised against a real database

activation_state.deployed_provider_version: pandora-projectos-learning v1, which does not contain these changes

remaining_gates: independent review of this exact candidate head
merge into canonical main with the exact-merge-result gates green
separate production deployment authorization and rollback rehearsal
